name: monday
description: monday.com-style work management app built with Next.js — live demo: https://monday-lemon-mu.vercel.app

paragraphs: A monday.com-style work management app: boards made of colored groups, typed columns, inline editing, automations, and five ways to look at the same work. It runs entirely in the browser — your workspace is saved to localStorage, so there is no backend, account or database to set up.
features: Workspaces with boards, favorites, recently visited, and board templates
(project management, bug tracking, sales pipeline, content calendar, team tasks, event planning)
Colored, collapsible groups with per-group summaries (status battery, sums/averages, date ranges)
11 column types — Status, People, Date, Timeline, Numbers, Text, Tags, Checkbox, Rating,
Link, Last updated — plus a Priority preset; labels and tags are editable in place
